feature: Packet-count renewal through session readiness for either handshake role
comparison: observed next send counter strictly greater than threshold
checks: Injected observations below, at and above threshold for both roles
Invalid plaintext leaves observed count unchanged
Successful encryption observes actual nonce from transport header
Previously used protocol session does not restart observed count after encryption
Fresh session does not request immediate renewal
limitations: Threshold predicates use synthetic observations, not 2^60 transmitted packets
Raw packet callers must invoke readiness explicitly
Keepalive timers and total retry-attempt limits remain unfinished
